# mistershell_configure_policy (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell configure policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_configure_stack" "baseline" {
  name = "device-baseline"
}

resource "mistershell_configure_policy" "example" {
  name           = "device-baseline-policy"
  stack_id       = tonumber(mistershell_configure_stack.baseline.id)
  enabled        = false
  resource_types = ["cisco_ios"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `stack_id` (Number) Stack id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `resource_types` (Dynamic) Resource types. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `tag_ids` (Dynamic) Tag ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `position` (Number) Position.
- `stack_name` (String) Stack name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_configure_policy.example 123
```
